title: Android RadioGroup: nested initial choice
purpose: Check an Android XML checkedButton reference to a RadioButton nested inside a container, and the framework's direct-child selection tracking.
changes: The importer accepts a uniquely identified nested RadioButton as checkedButton. The initial nested choice is checked, and choosing a direct child clears it.
steps: At the top under Nested initial choice, confirm Nested choice starts checked and Direct choice starts unchecked.
Tap Direct choice. It should become checked and Nested choice should clear.
Tap Nested choice again. Both may now be checked: Android RadioGroup automatically tracks direct RadioButton children, while this nested button is independent after the initial reference.
Use Reset nested choices to repeat; try right-to-left layout as well. Choose OK if it works, or Reject with details and your device.
expected: The nested initial reference is selected, a direct choice clears it, and later nested interaction remains independent, matching the documented framework behavior.
limits: This covers XML initialization and direct-child interaction. Programmatic group selection, nested group edge cases and Android device appearance remain unverified or incomplete.

references.scope: Initial descendant lookup and direct-child listener registration.

validation: Two nested RadioGroup runtime tests, 197 Android XML tests and 158 importer tests passed.
A 320 × 650 browser test checked initialization, direct and nested interaction, reset and RTL.
